{{Quote|M'lady, I'm so sorry. I've failed you, Senator.|Cordé's last words to Senator Padmé Amidala|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Cordé''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaiden]] and decoy for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the end of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==Biography==
While [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] was [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], the role of decoy was mainly filled by [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Cordé replaced her when Amidala stepped down from the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] and became the [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial representative]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. Like Sabé, Cordé worked closely with Padmé, and the two [[Gender/Legends|women]] became close friends.<ref name="SWOSVC28">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 28|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 28]]</ref>

[[File:PadmeCorde-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|185px|Amidala kneels with Cordé, shortly before she died.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Cordé was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on Amidala when the Senator returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. A [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was responsible for the attack. One of Amidala's other [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]], [[Versé/Legends|Versé]], and five [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo guards]] were also killed in the blast.<ref name="AOTC" />

Cordé died apologizing to Amidala, disheartened in thinking she had failed her duty to her mistress. On the contrary, the Senator was heartbroken by Cordé's sacrifice, regrettably accepting that she had performed her duty. At [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho's]] insistence, Amidala reluctantly left the bodies of Cordé and the other victims behind, promising herself that their sacrifice would not be in vain.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cordé was played by three people during her brief appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']]. She was played by [[Natalie Portman]] for her small scenes inside the [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|cruiser]] and walking down the [[Entry ramp/Legends|ramp]], by a stunt actress for the explosion, and by [[Veronica Segura]] for her death scene.<ref name="SWCtP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>
